packs.owner: The executive whose name is on the paper.
packs.cadence: Two scheduled briefings, and the review panel on demand before anything ships.
packs.one_line: Briefings, board papers, decision memos and the review panel before you send it
never_decides: The decision itself. A memo lays out options and a recommendation, and a person picks.
What is disclosed to a market, a regulator or an investor.
Whether a reviewer's objection is answered. The panel raises it; you answer it.
Which numbers are the official ones.
human_signs: Every board paper and every decision memo, as the author.
Any disclosure, through whatever process governs disclosures.
The figures, reconciled to the system of record rather than to the briefing.
The decision, recorded with the date and the options that were rejected.

packs.owner: The budget holder for the cost centre in question.
packs.cadence: Three scheduled watches, plus the monthly close checklist.
packs.one_line: Variance, close, invoice exceptions, renewals and the anomalies nobody watches
never_decides: Whether to pay an invoice. It flags the exception and names the approver.
Whether a variance is acceptable. It explains the arithmetic, not the tolerance.
Whether to renew or cancel a contract.
Any figure that goes into a statutory filing.
human_signs: Every payment exception, released by the person with the authority to release it.
The variance narrative before it reaches a board or an investor.
A renewal or a cancellation, in writing, before the notice window closes.
The close checklist, signed by the controller, not marked complete by the desk.

packs.owner: The HR business partner for the population affected.
packs.cadence: Event driven. Nothing here runs on a timer, deliberately.
packs.one_line: Job descriptions, onboarding, scorecards, policy answers and change comms
never_decides: Any outcome for a named person: hiring, rating, promotion, pay or exit.
Whether conduct has occurred, or how it should be treated.
Whether a policy applies to a specific case. It states what the policy says and routes the question.
Anything that would be an employment decision under local law.
human_signs: Every performance rating and every comment attached to a named person.
Every hiring decision, with the scorecard as one input among several.
Any policy interpretation before it is given to an employee as an answer.
All change communication, by the accountable leader, not the desk.

packs.owner: The service desk lead. Not the person who built the agent.
packs.cadence: Two scheduled routines overnight, the rest pulled when a ticket lands.
packs.one_line: Tickets, incidents, access requests and the knowledge base behind them
never_decides: Whether an access request is approved. It assembles the evidence and names who owns the decision.
Whether a change goes ahead. A change request pack is an input to CAB, not a substitute for it.
Root cause. A postmortem draft proposes one and marks it as unconfirmed until a person agrees.
When an incident is closed.
human_signs: The access decision on every line of an access review, by name.
The change request before it enters the approval queue.
The root cause statement in any postmortem that leaves the team.
Any knowledge article that will be read by someone outside the desk.

packs.owner: The project manager. The desk writes the update; the PM owns what it says.
packs.cadence: Two scheduled rollups, and one status pass per reporting cycle.
packs.one_line: Status, RAID, slippage, sprint reviews and the weekly rollup
never_decides: The RAG status. It proposes one from the evidence and the manager sets it.
Whether a risk is accepted, mitigated or escalated.
A date change. It explains the slip; rebaselining is a governance act.
Who is accountable for a missed action.
human_signs: The RAG status on every report that leaves the team.
Any date change, through whatever change control the programme runs.
Risk acceptance, by the person carrying the consequence.
Minutes, before they are treated as the record.

packs.owner: The quality manager, and for a document, its named custodian.
packs.cadence: One scheduled document watch, plus the audit calendar.
packs.one_line: Nonconformances, corrective actions, audit prep and document control
never_decides: Whether a nonconformance is closed.
Whether a corrective action was effective.
Any safety authorisation. Not a permit to work, not a lockout, not a confined space entry, not a JSA sign-off, not an inspection clearance.
The revision status of a controlled document.
human_signs: Every nonconformance closure, by the quality manager.
Effectiveness verification, with the evidence, not the intention.
Every controlled document revision, by its custodian, through the document control system.
Every safety authorisation, by an authorised person, with no agent output in the approval path.

packs.owner: The account owner. Every draft lands in their outbox, never in a customer's inbox.
packs.cadence: Two scheduled sweeps, the rest pulled ahead of a call.
packs.one_line: Discovery prep, qualification, deal risk, proposals and pipeline hygiene
never_decides: Whether to bid. A requirements pack informs the bid or no-bid meeting.
Price, discount or commercial terms.
A forecast commit. Qualification scoring is evidence for the conversation.
What is said to a customer. Every draft goes out under a person's name, after they have read it.
human_signs: Anything that reaches a customer, read in full first.
The commit, by the account owner, in the forecast review.
Every commercial term, through whatever delegation of authority applies.
A case study, by the customer, before it is published.

packs.owner: The control owner named in the register. The desk drafts for them, never instead of them.
packs.cadence: Two scheduled watches, plus whatever the audit calendar drags in.
packs.one_line: Control evidence, vendor risk, policy gaps and the regulatory diff
never_decides: Whether a control is effective. It gathers evidence and states what is missing.
Whether an incident is reportable to a regulator. It drafts the impact brief and stops.
Whether a vendor is acceptable. A screening brief is an input to a decision, not the decision.
The residual risk rating on any register line.
human_signs: Every control effectiveness conclusion, with the evidence reference.
Any regulator-facing statement, before it leaves the organisation.
The residual risk rating and the acceptance, by the risk owner.
A vendor approval, with the screening brief attached rather than quoted.

packs.owner: Whoever owns the agent estate. If nobody does, that is the first finding.
packs.cadence: Weekly, by hand, against the run logs of every other pack.
packs.one_line: Reads what the other desks produced, names what quietly stopped, brings three moves
never_decides: Whether a desk keeps running. It reports what stopped and who owns it.
Whether an output was correct. It checks whether an output happened at all.
Anything about a person's performance. A desk that stopped is an operational fact, not an appraisal.
human_signs: The weekly review itself, read by a person, not filed by one.
Any decision to retire, pause or change a desk.
The list of desks currently running, confirmed against reality rather than against this repository.
